## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` 的「向其他应用贡献导航」一节补一段话、示例加一个 `order: 30`;导航条目表的 `order` 行补半句「其他包贡献的条目也在同一层参与排序」。另在 objectql 现有的导航贡献测试文件里加 3 条钉子,钉住合并时贡献条目的 `order` 原样保留。
- 为什么改:文档只讲了 `group` 和 `priority`,下游以为模块的条目只能排在应用自有条目之后。实际上合并原样保留 `order`,控制台按 `order` 排每一层,所以 `order: 25` 会排在应用的 20 和 30 之间,前提是应用给自己的条目编了号。这是 #33234 裁定 C(不改)后留给文档的缺口。
- 风险与回滚:不改任何运行代码,不改 spec;只有一页文档和一个测试文件。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` L863 起的新段落;`packages/objectql/src/registry-nav-contribution-group-semantics.test.ts` L509 起的新 `describe`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-nav-contribution-group-semantics.test.ts`,预期 13 条全绿(原 10 条 + 新 3 条)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`content/docs/ui/apps.mdx`, the `navigationContributions` section (L863).** One paragraph: the merge appends a contribution's items to the end of their group (or the top level) as written, `order` included; the console then sorts each level by `order` (the top level, each group's children, the mobile tab bar), so `order: 25` is drawn between the app's own `20` and `30`. No `order` sorts as `0`; equal `order` keeps the merged sequence, so `priority` decides only between contributions whose items have the same `order`; the target app has to number its own entries, otherwise a contribution stays after them. The example's `nav_webhooks` item gains `order: 30` (L847).
- **Same file, the Navigation items table's `order` row (L297).** One clause: entries contributed by another package sort in the same level, linking to the section.
- **`packages/objectql/src/registry-nav-contribution-group-semantics.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` (L509)**, beside the existing group/priority propositions in the same harness file: a host app that numbers its entries plus contributor modules, installed as one artifact through the manifest service, read with `registry.getApp`.
  - In a group: `sales_group` children read `[nav_accounts, 10], [nav_contacts, 30], [nav_cpq, 20]`: appended, not sorted in, `order` untouched.
  - At the top level: `[nav_home, 10], [sales_group, 20], [nav_reports, 30], [nav_forecast, 25]`.
  - An item with no `order` has no `order` key after the fold, in a group or at the top level.

What the code does, read on `origin/main` `19cc8976` before writing: `SchemaRegistry.applyNavContributions` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` L11003) pushes `c.items` into the group's `children` (L11024) or the top level (L11034 relocation, L11037 no group) with no map or sort; the console's one comparator is `byNavOrder` in `ui/packages/layout/src/navOrder.ts` (`(a.order ?? 0) - (b.order ?? 0)`, stable sort), used at `NavigationRenderer.tsx` L2113 (top level) and L1797 (a group's children) and `AppSchemaRenderer.tsx` L327 (mobile tab bar). That comparator is pinned by `ui/packages/layout/src/__tests__/AppSchemaRenderer.mobileTabOrder-11395.test.tsx`; this PR does not re-test it.

No source line moves, nothing in `packages/spec` changes, no new key, no `before` / `after`, no landing on a contributed entry (#33234 ruled C, record 6884379643).

- **Docs gate on the example (measured).** `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` is in `check:skill-examples`' docs root, but only fences under an `os:check` marker are type-checked; the page has 4 marked fences and the `navigationContributions` example fence is not one of them, so no snippet type-check runs on the edited block. The new in-page link `#contributing-navigation-to-another-app` is read by `check:doc-anchors` (exit 0).
- **No changeset, `skip-changeset`.** `@objectstack/objectql` ships `files: [dist, README.md, CHANGELOG.md]`; a `*.test.ts` is not in its build, and `content/docs/**` is in no package. No published byte moves.
- **Ablation A3 versus the console.** A fold that sorted would also draw the right menu, so A3 going red is the pin doing what the card asked (the fold never re-sorts); the drawn order is the console's job and is pinned there.
